newsitem.title: USA: Tampa to guarantee Florida Aquarium loan -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Tampa to guarantee Florida Aquarium loan -- paper.

text.p: City of Tampa agreed to guarantee a $1.2 million bank loan to cover operating losses at the Florida Aquarium, the Tampa Tribune said Wednesday.
Tampa Finance Director Henry Innis said the aquarium expects an $850,000 million deficit for the year ending Sept 30 and a deficit of about $500,000 in 1998, which may require another loan.

A report due out next week by entertainment experts at the Anheuser-Busch Co projects the city-owned aquarium will be profitable by 1998. The report, performed at no cost to taxpayers, will encourage the aquarium to make changes in its exhibits, the newspaper said.
Financial problems have plagued the aquarium since it opened in March 1995. Attendence fell nearly 800,000 short of the 1.8 million first-year projection, and has not improved.
The city took over the aquarium and refinanced its bonds last October.
